about: Figures for osek-zair.html that no primary text read in this repository states. osek-zair.html renders none of them and no page or module loads this file; CONFIG_PUBLISH_RULES gives it the 'verified' rule, so a shipped page that loaded it would stop the build. A value leaves this file only when a rendered primary text states it: then it moves into osek-zair.json with that capture's line as its cite, and is deleted here. The one exception ever recorded is undone: on 29.9.2026 the 2026 cap (122,833) left this file on nevo's consolidated text of the VAT law, which is not a primary text (record: logs/2026-09-29-osek-zair-2026.md, section 4); on 6.10.2026 that capture was marked [robots-bar] (research/channel-loop/RULING-2026-10-06-robots-and-terms.md, decision 1), so it is no product input, and the cap is back here (years.2026). A second exception is not the loop's to grant (decision 1(6)). The rule itself is unchanged.

2026.grade: nevo capture [robots-bar] (ruling 6.10 row 21 (a)); not a product input
2026.toVerify: Render a primary text that states the 2026 עוסק פטור amount - the notice in Reshumot of the 1.1.2026 CPI adjustment under VAT law section 126(א), a gov.il page of the Tax Authority, or a Tax Authority circular - cite its capture line, move the amount it states into osek-zair.json `years` with that cite (facts.cap), and remove 2026 from `pendingYears` there and from this file. Wikisource may corroborate beside such a text, never replace it (ruling 6.10 row 21 (a), decision 1(4)).

vatLawSense.grade: statute mirror quoted in the repo, not rendered: research/colony-sweep/scouts/risk-governance--selling-as-individual.md:132 quotes תקנות מע"מ (רישום) 15א(ג) ("עוסק זעיר לענין סעיף 31(3) לחוק"); research/tiktok/08-reads/hebrew-israel.md:244 repeats it. For the law itself it is contradicted by a rendered text read on 29.9.2026: nevo's consolidated VAT law (see `why`), a capture marked [robots-bar] on 6.10.2026 (ruling 6.10 row 21 (a)) that serves only the decision not to cite 31(3), never as a product input.
vatLawSense.why: The page used to say, as secondary, that עוסק זעיר is also a VAT-law term, and this section number was held here for it. Nevo's consolidated VAT law (research/rendered/nevo-vat-law-2026-09-29.txt, current to 13-07-2026), read on 29.9.2026, shows otherwise for the law: the definition of "עוסק זעיר" reads "(נמחקה)" (line 89), section 31(3) reads "(3) עסקאות של עוסק פטור" (line 484), and the phrase is otherwise only in the headings over repealed sections 42 and 57 (lines 610-611, 782-783). From 29.9 to 6.10.2026 the page said that, cited to those lines (osek-zair.json facts.vatSense); on 6.10.2026 facts.vatSense left with every nevo cite (ruling 6.10 row 21 (a), decision 1(5)), no pinned excerpt of a permitted text of the law was in the repository to re-cite it to, and the page now says nothing about the phrase in the VAT law. It never cites 31(3). What stays unread is the regulation the mirror quotes. תקנות מס ערך מוסף (רישום) were rendered on 29.9.2026 (research/rendered/nevo-vat-registration-regs.txt, fetched 13:02:22Z), and no reading of 15א(ג) in that capture is recorded; on 6.10.2026 it too was marked [robots-bar] (ruling 6.10 row 21 (a), decision 1(2)), so it cannot settle this entry. Whether 15א(ג) still speaks of 'עוסק זעיר לענין סעיף 31(3) לחוק' is not known from any text this entry may use.
vatLawSense.toVerify: Nothing here is to move onto the page: the law's own text, where read, contradicts it. Never settle this entry from the capture of 29.9.2026 (nevo-vat-registration-regs): it is [robots-bar], no product input, and a later permission does not reach back. Wait for a permitted text of תקנות מס ערך מוסף (רישום) - a copy on a host whose terms and robots.txt allow the runner, pinned in the repository (the lawsofisrael mirror on GitHub that decision 1(5) names for the VAT law holds them as consolidated to 2016: MREG in research/measurements/osek-patur-documents.md:1213, reg 15א at MREG:403-414), or a fresh nevo fetch only once the ruling's REOPEN IF holds (nevo's robots.txt allows MehudakRenderWatch or * on /law_html/, or nevo publishes terms that allow a runner); then read 15א(ג) there, record what it says, and delete this entry either way.
